scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web,mobile "npm run dev -w @transit/shared" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @transit/web
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @transit/server
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @transit/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @transit/server && npm run build -w @transit/web && npm run build -w @transit/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:shared && npm run test:unit --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && node scripts/smoke.mjs
